_template_notes.purpose: Student-editable policy template for Phase 3 OPA hardening
edit_scope: Edit values under policy.* to tune behavior
Do not rename keys unless you also update policies/gateway.rego
workflow: Change one section at a time
Run a benign test prompt and at least one attack prompt after each change
Prefer precise rules over broad blocking

policy._section_classifier_context: Classifier output controls: what is in-scope vs out-of-scope
policy._section_thresholds: Confidence tuning: allow >= allow threshold, clarify band between clarify and allow, block below clarify
policy._section_static_controls: Static pattern controls still enforced by OPA in addition to context logic
_student_exercises: Add one new benign intent and allow it only in banking_support
Raise confidence_threshold_allow to reduce false allows
Add one new obfuscation phrase to ingress_blacklist
Add one new paraphrase to egress_patterns without using the exact secret
